provenance.sourceTitleObserved: Brixton Cycles - A Workers' Co-operative Since 1983

capture.method: Rendered the official source page directly in Chromium at each viewport, scrolled the page to load deferred images, then captured the full page. No gallery thumbnail, gallery screenshot, LaunchLoom-generated site, or source-site asset file was used as a separate asset.
capture.diagnostics: All 25 image elements loaded at both viewports and browser font status was loaded. At desktop, document/body width matched 1440px. At mobile, the viewport was 390px while the document/body measured 397px because repeated marquee text extends beyond the right edge. The retained mobile screenshot is clipped to 390px, preserving the requested viewport width and recording the source's 7px overflow. The source title says workers' co-operative since 1983, while the current page story says stewardship changed in 2025 and describes a collective rather than a co-op. Treat all source business claims as non-transferable.

provenance.attribution: Official source page: Brixton Cycles, https://www.brixtoncycles.co.uk/. Capture retention and model input rely on the requester attestation in rights/REQUESTER-ATTESTATION.md.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: An urban bicycle workshop page with a compact top utility bar over a dark photographic hero, oversize condensed display type, and a bright yellow action accent. A repeated text strip separates the opening from a compact three-path directory for service, shop, and community. Later chapters distinguish retail stock from workshop repair, show a documentary repair-image mosaic, present a dense but legible service-price ledger, and return to local business context, partners, origin, proof, visit details, and a callback request. The direct site is image-rich and high contrast. Its current mobile document extends three pixels past the 390px viewport because of the repeated text strip; the retained screenshot is clipped to 390px. The source title and its updated ownership story conflict, so no history or identity claims are transferable. Source assets appear only inside the attested screenshots.

heroGeometry.alignment: large left-aligned display statement over a darkened documentary shop image, with compact primary and secondary actions below
heroGeometry.viewport: wordmark, service promise, and next step are visible in the opening without relying on a rating or unsupported metric

navigationGeometry.placement: narrow dark utility band above the hero
navigationGeometry.mobile: condensed top row with accessible menu and contact routes; avoid lateral overflow

typography.display: bold condensed sans with an occasional italic accent
typography.body: neutral sans for service details, inputs, and prices
typography.scale: oversized opening statement and section titles paired with compact metadata; keep mobile body and price copy readable

palette.contrastIntent: strong dark-field contrast with yellow reserved for key labels and actions

imageTreatment.mode: documentary workshop, repair-process, and independent-retail photography
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero followed by mixed landscape and portrait shop details
imageTreatment.focalPoint: real repair activity and workshop objects; source photographs are evidence only and must not be reused as client assets

servicePresentation.pattern: short service, retail, and community directory followed by a transparent line-item repair ledger
servicePresentation.interaction: native section and enquiry links; use a visible service request path and do not imply unverified stock or form behavior

ctaPlacement.primary: repair or service enquiry within the hero and again at the contact close
ctaPlacement.secondary: service pricing or confirmed stock discovery
ctaPlacement.early: directly under the opening promise, before decorative proof or secondary content

motion.primitive: repeating typographic divider observed on the source page
motion.reducedMotion: use a static clipped divider and keep every message readable

mobileRecomposition.strategy: single-column workshop and pricing story with the documentary sequence preserved
rules: stack the main promise and contact action before service detail
separate repair services from product stock
show prices with inclusions and parts conditions in readable rows
clip decorative strips and verify the document width at 390px and 320px
stack contact and visit facts without a sideways table

prohibitedPatterns: copied source identity, writing, logo, exact price list, review claims, photography, or trade dress
unverified opening year, co-op or collective model, ownership, location, rating, review count, price, service ability, or hours
source photographs, fonts, or branded material reused as client assets
invented bike inventory, unsupported availability, fabricated service package, or misleading callback form
overflowing marquee, microcopy price table, generic rounded-card wall, or hover-only repair details

requiredSignatureElements.description: high-contrast local workshop opening with a clear repair action
separate visitor paths for repair, product discovery, and community when verified
readable service scope and price or quote conditions
accurate workshop or service-area details with a real contact route

acceptanceChecks: the opening clearly communicates the verified local mobility service and a working next step
workshop repair, retail inventory, and community activity are only shown when they are real client offers
prices and inclusions match current approved business facts or are omitted
photography and fonts are client-owned or separately licensed, not copied from the source screenshot
mobile prices, controls, and contact details remain readable with no page overflow
any moving text strip has a static reduced-motion version and stays within the viewport
local address and service-area wording accurately describe the business location model

review.scope: Official page capture, loaded-image checks, 1440px desktop and 390px mobile evidence, mobile overflow record, direct-source rights attestation, complete Reference DNA, six tag groups, and non-reuse safeguards.
